999008199.text:
ふうむ。
今のところ、仙人の実の影すら見当たらず……

localizations.en: Hmm. So far, we haven't even seen a shadow of the Sage Fruit...

999008199.text:
ですが、必ずや見つけます！
待っていて、鏑矢様……！

localizations.en: But we will surely find it! Please hang in there, Lady Kaburaya...!

999008199.text: ……鬼門って、鏑矢の部下なのよね？

左様でございます。
拙者は鏑矢様の刀でございまする

localizations.en: That is correct. I am Lady Kaburaya's blade.

999008199.text:
でも……なんか鏑矢のことを話してるとき
もっと仲がいい感じがする。私にとっての姉様みたいな

localizations.en: But when you talk about her, it feels like you're closer than that. Almost like how I am with Alvina.

999008199.text:
も、申し訳ございませぬ。頭では分かっていても
長年染みついた癖がなかなか抜けず……

localizations.en: M-my apologies. I understand the present reality of our relationship, but old habits formed over many years are hard to break...

999008199.text: 仲がいいのは別に謝ることでもないと思うけど……

localizations.en: I don't think being close to someone is something you need to apologize for...

999008199.text:
鏑矢は鬼門を友達のように
対等に扱っていたからね

localizations.en: Kaburaya has always treated Kimon as an equal, akin to a friend.

999008199.text:
自分がもらった異国のおやつを半分わけてやったり
自分が見つけた珍しい虫を譲ってやったり

localizations.en: She'd share any foreign sweets she receive, or gift her the rare insects she'd find.

999008199.text:
それでは主従関係のけじめが付かないですし
虫は正直、もらっても困ったのですが……

localizations.en: That doesn't respect the professional boundaries between lord and ninja. And honestly? I never did know what I was supposed to do with the insects...

999008199.text:
歳の近い忍びも少なく、一番長い時間共にいたので
どこか友のように感じている部分はございます

localizations.en: There were few other ninjas my age, and we spent most of our time together, so I do feel somewhat like a friend to her.

999008199.text:
そっか……二人は友達でもあるんだにゃ。
ちょっと思い出すにゃあ、あたしの大切にゃ友達

localizations.en: I see... so you two are friends too. That reminds me of someone special to me too.

999008199.text:
鏑矢はよく言ってたよ。
自分の忍びを手駒ではなく友として扱って何が悪いと

localizations.en: Kaburaya often said there was nothing wrong with treating her ninja as friends over just simply pawns.

999008199.text:
そのような古きしきたりは足枷にしかならない。
変化を恐れては世界に置いていかれるであろう……

localizations.en: Such old customs only serve as shackles. Fear change, and the world will leave you behind...

999008199.text:
拙者も鏑矢様の言葉に感化され
常に新しいものを模索するようになりました

localizations.en: I too was influenced by Lady Kaburaya's words and began constantly seeking new things.

999008199.text:
同じことをやり続けるだけじゃなくて
新しいことにも挑戦する、その意気込みは素敵だわ

localizations.en: So not just repeating things ad infinitum, but challenging yourself with new experiences—that's a wonderful attitude.

999008199.text:
そうでしょう？　最近は焼きそばにパンを散らした
パン焼きそばも発明いたしました

localizations.en: Indeed! Recently I even invented bread fried noodles by... well, sprinkling bread over fried noodles.

999008199.text:
挑戦した結果、実験台にされて
俺や近くの者に被害が出るってわけさ

localizations.en: And as a result of those... inspiration... I and many others end up as unwitting test subjects.

999008199.text:
あはは……でも、そういう挑戦も大切だよ。あたしの
友達も、昔は自分の気持ちを抑えてたんだけど……

localizations.en: Ahaha... But trying new things is important for sure. A friend of mine used to suppress her own feelings...

999008199.text:
我慢せず自分のやりたいこともやるようになって
前よりもっと素敵になったんだよ

localizations.en: But when she stopped holding back and started doing what she wanted, she quickly surpassed her limits.

999008199.text:
そういう意味では、挑戦しろって鏑矢さんの主張も
分かるんだよね。ちょっと過激になってるけど……

localizations.en: In that sense, I can understand Kaburaya's viewpoint on always challenging oneself. Even if she's taking it to an extreme right now...

999008199.text: ソフィーさん……
な、なんて語ってみたりして、えへへ……

localizations.en: L-listen to me getting all philosophical, hehe...

999008199.text: 猫語が直ってる！

そっち！？
直ってよかったけど！！

localizations.en: That's all you took away from that?! I'm glad that's over and done with, though!!

999008199.text:
ははは……さ、そろそろ社も最奥だ
まだ採れてない素材もそこにあるはずさ

localizations.en: Hahaha... Come on, we're almost at the innermost part of the shrine. The materials we still need should be there.

999008199.text:
参りましょう。
待っていて、鏑矢様……！

localizations.en: Let us proceed. Please hang in there, Lady Kaburaya...!
